newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged, seen steady.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained unchanged on Monday. Demand from mills outstripped supply and dealers said prices would remain firm until the arrival of new supplies picks up by mid-September.

"The new crop arrival (1997/98 July-June) is slow and demand outpaces supply," dealer Shamimul Haq said. "Prices will maintain the current level until supply from Punjab (province) starts in mid-September."
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was quoted around 2,250 ($55.39) to 2,260 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
